t: You are looking at the statue of Florence Nightingale in Waterloo Place. Arthur George Walker sculpted it in 1915. It is Grade II listed and forms a subsidiary part of the Guards Crimean War Memorial. Nightingale is the founder of modern nursing. In the Crimean War she organised care for wounded soldiers, and better hygiene and living conditions cut death rates significantly. She became known as the Lady with the Lamp, making her night rounds on the wards. Thomas Henry Wyatt, a past president of the Royal Institute of British Architects, is credited with the design.
